column1: Signal Sweet Cheeks that you're ready to begin the operation by ordering a drink. She'll pretend to recognize you as 'Whitey,' an old friend recently released from prison. She'll introduce you to bartender Woody Roberts, whom we believe is the contact man for the back room hustle.
column2: 「跟 Sweet Cheeks 點一杯酒，示意你已經準備好展開行動。她會假裝認出你是剛出獄的老朋友『Whitey』。她會把你介紹給酒保 Woody Roberts，我們認為他就是後房賭局的聯絡人。」

column1: You'll be carrying a large sum of money (in marked bills, of course), and will pretend to be eager for action.
column2: 「你會帶著一大筆錢（當然是做了記號的鈔票），並假裝自己躍躍欲試。」

column1: %m85 concludes, "Since Laura developed your disguise, I'll let her fill you in on its details."
column2: %m85 總結道：「既然你的偽裝是 Laura 設計的，細節就讓她跟你說明。」

column1: Sonny, I've picked out a white suit for you, Laura says, "and, by the way, we've decided your hair must be bleached!"
column2: 「Sonny，我幫你挑了一套白色西裝，」Laura 說，「對了，我們決定你的頭髮必須漂白！」

column1: You'll walk with the aid of this special cane. Its handle is really a detachable, .22-caliber magnum Derringer. When the need arises, you will carry a voice transmitter disguised as a plain-looking ballpoint pen.
column2: 「你要靠這根特製手杖走路。它的握把其實是一把可拆卸的 .22 麥格農口徑 Derringer 手槍。必要時，你還會帶著一支偽裝成普通原子筆的語音發報器。」

column1: That's all I have, concludes Laura. "Sweet Cheeks, do you have anything to add?"
column2: 「我要說的就這些，」Laura 總結道。「Sweet Cheeks，妳還有什麼要補充的嗎？」

column1: In an excited voice, Sweet Cheeks says, "Oh, Sonny, I'm so happy I get to work with you! Why, it almost brings a tear to my eye! I'm looking forward to spending tonight working with you at the Hotel Delphoria, my Precious!" She winks at you.
column2: Sweet Cheeks 用興奮的聲音說：「喔，Sonny，能和你一起行動我好開心！我都快感動得掉淚了！今晚能在 Delphoria 飯店和你共事，我好期待呢，我的寶貝！」她朝你眨了眨眼。

column1: Sergeant Dooley, his voice cracking, interrupts the meeting.
column2: Dooley 警佐聲音顫抖地打斷了會議。

column1: It is my regretful duty to inform you that I've just received a phone call from Jack Cobb. His daughter, Kathy, just died without ever regaining conciousness.
column2: 「我很遺憾必須通知各位，我剛接到 Jack Cobb 的電話。他的女兒 Kathy 剛剛過世了，始終沒有恢復意識。」

column1: Effective immediately, Jack is on extended family leave. Jack's taking this really hard. His brother is staying with him and he requests no visitors. I'm sure our sympathy goes out to Jack in his time of need.
column2: 「即日起，Jack 請延長家庭假。Jack 承受得很辛苦，他哥哥留下來陪他，他也希望暫時不見訪客。我相信大家都會在他最需要的時候給予慰問。」

column1: Hatred wells up inside you. You vow revenge for Kathy's senseless death by tracking down the dope world animals responsible!
column2: 一股恨意在你心中湧起。你發誓要追查出害死 Kathy 的那群毒品世界禽獸，為她這場毫無意義的死報仇！

column1: %m85 speaks softly, "Sonny, the sooner you get into the scene at the Hotel Delphoria, the sooner we can neutralize those blood suckers."
column2: %m85 輕聲說：「Sonny，你越早混進 Delphoria 飯店的場子，我們就能越早鏟除那些吸血鬼。」

column1: Laura adds, "I picked up these supplies at the beauty shop. Take this bottle of bleach creme activator into the shower and bleach your hair."
column2: Laura 補充道：「我在美容院買了這些用品。把這瓶漂白霜活化劑拿進淋浴間，把頭髮漂白。」

column1: %m85 instructs you, "Sonny, after you bleach your hair and change clothes, report back to me. I have more instructions for you."
column2: %m85 吩咐你：「Sonny，漂白頭髮、換好衣服後回來找我，我還有其他指示要交代。」

column1: It's good to see you, Sonny. Come over to my desk.
I know you worked hard trying to keep that punk Hoffman in jail. What a shame that it was all for naught!
column2: 「我知道你費了很大力氣想把 Hoffman 那個小混混關在牢裡。真可惜，全都白費了！」

column1: It's frustrating when a man does the best job he can do, and some dummy screws it up! I wouldn't trust that tower guard to guard our water fountain!
column2: 「一個人已經盡力做好份內的事，卻被某個蠢蛋搞砸，真令人洩氣！那個崗哨警衛連看管飲水機都信不過！」

column1: After reviewing the Hoffman file, I think we should take a close look at the black book that was impounded along with his Cadillac. Get it from Russ in the evidence lockup.
column2: 「看過 Hoffman 的檔案後，我覺得我們該仔細查查那本連同 Cadillac 一起被扣押的黑色記事本。去證物室找 Russ 拿。」

column1: Check it out, then get back to me. I have some other leads to investigate. When we next meet, I may have some new ideas.
column2: 「查完之後回來找我。我還有其他線索要追查，下次見面時，我可能會有新想法。」

column1: Come over to my desk. I have some things to discuss with you.
column2: 「過來我桌邊，我有些事要跟你討論。」

column1: After you infiltrate the illegal gambling activities at the hotel, contact me. I'll send over a team of detectives to serve as your backups.
column2: 「等你滲透進旅館的非法賭博活動後，跟我聯絡。我會派一組警探過去當你的支援。」

column1: This envelope contains a thousand dollars in marked, hundred-dollar bills.
column2: 「這個信封裡裝著一千美元，全是做了記號的百元鈔票。」

column1: Use your head, Sonny, and don't forget: we want Mr. Big!
column2: 「動動腦，Sonny，別忘了：我們要的是 Mr. Big！」

column1: Just then the office intercom squelches, "%m85. Homicide detective Oscar Hamilton on line three."
column2: 就在這時，辦公室對講機傳出雜訊：「%m85，命案組 Oscar Hamilton 警探，三線。」

column1: You patiently wait while %m83 grumbles on the phone.
column2: 你耐心等著，%m83 在電話裡發著牢騷。

column1: When the conversation ends, %m83 relates Hamilton's comments on the floater found this morning at Cotton Cove.
column2: 談話結束後，%m83 轉述 Hamilton 對今天早上在 Cotton Cove 發現的那具浮屍的看法。

column1: Sonny, it seems that Hoffman/Taselli was shot execution-style before he decided to take his little swim.
column2: 「Sonny，看來 Hoffman／Taselli 是先被人以處決方式槍殺，之後才『下水游泳』的。」

column1: It looks like you're walking right into the dragon's lair at the Hotel Delphoria. Be careful, boy!
column2: 「看來你正要走進 Delphoria 飯店這個龍潭虎穴。小心點，小子！」

column1: Well, that's it here, %m83 says. "Now, go meet Sweet Cheeks and get this campaign rolling."
column2: 「這裡的事就這樣了，」%m83 說。「現在去見 Sweet Cheeks，讓這場行動開始吧。」

column1: Sonny, change into a more suitable garb, and Code-3 yourself back in here!
column2: 「Sonny，換上比較合適的裝扮，然後用 Code-3 趕回來這裡！」

column1: Hello, Sonny. I hear your 'little' Sweetheart is in the can!
column2: 「哈囉，Sonny。聽說你那位『小』甜心被關起來了！」

column1: Sonny, I think your friend, Sweet Cheeks, may be able to help us out.
column2: 「Sonny，我想你的朋友 Sweet Cheeks 或許能幫上我們的忙。」

column1: It seems our drug problem is emanating from the Hotel Delphoria.
column2: 「看來我們的毒品問題，源頭就在 Delphoria 飯店。」

column1: In lieu of her current state of affairs, I'd bet Sweet Cheeks would be willing to help you establish your cover at the Hotel.
column2: 「考量到她目前的處境，我敢說 Sweet Cheeks 會願意幫你在飯店裡建立掩護身分。」

column1: Go over to the jail, and see if she'll help you with the hotel operation.
column2: 「去監獄一趟，看看她願不願意在飯店行動上幫你。」

column1: When you get back, I'll hold a briefing on the operation.
column2: 「等你回來，我會針對這次行動召開簡報。」

column1: I'll call the jail and arrange everything for you.
column2: 「我會打電話給監獄，幫你安排好一切。」

column1: I can't believe Judge Palmer fell for that bunk about a stolen ID.
column2: 「真不敢相信 Palmer 法官居然相信那套什麼身分證被偷的鬼話。」

column1: By the way, we learned from the fingerprint search that Hoffman is really one 'Jason Taselli' recently of Chicago.
column2: 「對了，我們透過指紋比對查出，Hoffman 其實是最近從芝加哥來的『Jason Taselli』。」

column1: Sweet Cheeks, says %m85, "why don't you head on over to the hotel. Sonny will follow shortly."
column2: %m85 說：「Sweet Cheeks，妳先過去飯店吧，Sonny 隨後就到。」

column1: Thanks for your help, Laura, %m83 says, "that's all for now."
column2: 「謝謝妳的幫忙，Laura，」%m83 說，「目前就先這樣。」

column1: Mr. Bains, please rise for sentencing. Do you have any last statement before I pronounce sentencing?
column2: 「Bains 先生，請起立聽候判決。宣判前，你有什麼要說的嗎？」

column1: Bains looks straight into your eyes. "No, your Honor."\n\nThen, under his breath, he hisses across the aisle, "Bonds, you're a dead man!"
column2: Bains 直視著你的雙眼。「沒有，法官大人。」\n\n接著，他壓低聲音，隔著走道朝你嘶聲說道：「Bonds，你死定了！」

column1: Staring intently at Bains, Judge Palmer says firmly, "Jessie Hiram Bains, you are hereby sentenced to a total of 97 years in the State Penitentiary, without possibility of parole."
column2: Palmer 法官緊盯著 Bains，語氣堅定地說：「Jessie Hiram Bains，本庭判處你在州立監獄服刑，總計九十七年，不得假釋。」

column1: The courtroom erupts in spontaneous applause. You smile broadly, until you catch Bains glaring holes through your skull! You know your life is not yet free of "the Death Angel!"
column2: 法庭裡爆出一陣自發的掌聲。你咧嘴大笑，直到瞥見 Bains 用彷彿要瞪穿你腦袋的眼神盯著你！你知道，你的人生還沒有真正擺脫「死亡天使」的陰影！

column1: Three days pass.\n\nWith Bains safely ensconced in the State Penitentiary at Vacaville, the City of Lytton is once again a quiet, peaceful community freed from the grasp of "the Death Angel."
column2: 三天過去了。\n\n隨著 Bains 安穩地被關進 Vacaville 州立監獄，Lytton 市再度成為一個安靜祥和、擺脫「死亡天使」魔掌的社區。

column1: Bailiff, please read the jury's verdict to the court.
column2: 「法警，請向本庭宣讀陪審團的裁決。」

column1: Bailiff, please bring the jury's verdict to me.
column2: 「法警，請把陪審團的裁決呈給我。」

column1: Following a ticker tape parade down Main Street in your honor, a huge crowd has gathered on the Courthouse steps.
column2: 為向你致敬，遊行隊伍沿著 Main Street 舉行了一場彩帶遊行，結束後，法院台階前聚集了大批群眾。

column1: Mayor Fuddrucker and Chief Whipplestick wait at the top of the steps, while you pass through the Department Honor Guard.
column2: Fuddrucker 市長與 Whipplestick 局長在台階頂端等候，你則穿過警局的榮譽儀隊。

column1: Sonny Bonds, the Mayor reads, "as Mayor, I wish to express the appreciation of the people of the City of Lytton for your service to them, and present you with this expression of our gratitude, the Key to the City!"
column2: 市長宣讀：「Sonny Bonds，身為市長，我謹代表 Lytton 市全體市民，對你的貢獻表達感謝之意，並致贈這份謝禮——本市之鑰！」
恭喜你，你已經打贏了「警察故事」！
